passages.text: The more we grow in love and virtue and holiness, the more we see love and virtue and holiness outside. All condemnation of others really condemns ourselves. Adjust the microcosm (which is in your power to do) and the macrocosm will adjust itself for you.
Every step that has been really gained in the world has been gained by love; criticising can never do any good, it has been tried for thousand of years. Condemnation accomplishes nothing.
passages.note: Urge to criticise; love achieves more

passages.text: Never ask that foolish question, what good will it do to the world? Let the world go. Love and ask nothing; love and look for nothing further. Love and forget all the “isms”.
passages.note: Doubting whether love or effort matters

passages.text:
“There was a time when I was a woman and he was a man.
Still love grew until there was neither he nor I;
Only I remember faintly there was a time when there were two.
But love came between and made them one.”
passages.note: Deep love and union with another

passages.text: All hatred is killing the “Self by the self”, therefore love is the law of life.
passages.note: Hatred harms oneself; love as the law
